project:providio-os: Turns the signals an airline's commercial teams receive each day into decisions a person can approve.
page:project:providio-os: Hundreds of thousands of signals reach an airline's commercial teams every morning.
project:reet: Research on shrinking an AI agent's context by keeping the facts instead of trimming the words. Paused; small experiments, honestly reported.
page:project:reet: An agent's context keeps growing, and every token is paid for on every call.
project:sre-incident-env: A test of whether an AI agent can fix a simulated production outage, where a wrong fix makes things worse.
page:project:sre-incident-env: Most agent tests for operations stop at naming the cause of an outage.
project:ecommerce-classifier: Reads a product's photo and its title and files it into one of 434 grocery and household categories.
page:project:ecommerce-classifier: An online store needs every product in the right category for search and recommendations to work.
project:recall: A private place to save what you read and find it again by idea, not only by keyword.
page:project:recall: Saved articles pile up in bookmarks and are never found again, and most tools that fix this keep a copy of your reading on someone else's server.
project:mindscroll: Turns a book into a chapter-by-chapter course of flashcards, quizzes and summaries.
page:project:mindscroll: Finishing a book is not the same as remembering it.
project:mutual-match: A matching system that introduces two people only when each is near the top of the other's list.
page:project:mutual-match: A matchmaking app kept introducing each person to their highest-scoring candidate, who often did not feel the same.
project:dating-env: A simulated dating world where you write a matching rule and see how many couples it finds. It approximates the article's method.
page:project:dating-env: A matching method is hard to judge from a description, and the data that could test it belongs to real people.
project:photo-to-paint: Turns a photo into a paint-by-numbers kit you can print and paint, from the assessment to the painting guide.
page:project:photo-to-paint: A paint-by-numbers picture is easy to make on a screen.
project:anima: A few painted views of a character become a head you can turn and give expressions, drawn as a five-grey pixel-art sprite sheet.
page:project:anima: Asked to hold an exact head angle, keep a character's likeness and draw in pixel art all at once, an image model could do none of them reliably.
project:resolve-free-mcp: Lets an AI assistant edit video in the free edition of DaVinci Resolve.
page:project:resolve-free-mcp: DaVinci Resolve only lets outside programs control it in the paid edition.
project:adalyst-mcp: Lets an AI assistant look up a brand's live ads on Facebook and Instagram and describe what they are doing.
page:project:adalyst-mcp: Checking what competitors are advertising means searching ad libraries by hand, one brand and one ad at a time.
project:unscroll: A tiny Android app that notices when you open YouTube Shorts or Instagram Reels and sends you back to the home screen.
page:project:unscroll: Short-form video is opened by reflex.
project:portfolio-analyzer: Keeps the facts about your investments with a source and a date on each, so an assistant can cite them instead of guessing.
page:project:portfolio-analyzer: Ask a language model about a portfolio and it answers from memory: a ratio with no date and a different figure each time.
